notes.learning: From 'kọ̀mpútà' (borrowed from English 'computer') + 'alágbèéká' (that which is carried under the arm). The combination refers to a portable computer.

examples: Mo fi kọ̀mpútà alágbèéká ṣe iṣẹ́ mi. (I use my laptop for work)
Kọ̀mpútà alágbèéká mi ti ku. (My laptop is dead)
data.subject: Economics
